'''EchoBaseTrooper Bring Him Before Me''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[EchoBaseTrooper]]
* '''Published:''' 14 July 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS4]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Bring Him Before Me
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS4 BHBM EchoBaseTrooper DS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Imperial Domination (V), General Veers (V), Commander Praji (V), Blizzard 1 (V), Blizzard 2 (V), Blizzard Scout 1 (V), Imperial Reinforcements (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

BHBM deck that uses Imperial Domination(V) to retrieve that one force you lose every turn...

== Notes ==

* The draft had dropped the objective (posted 'BHBM/TYFP').
* Original-era (V): Commander Praji (V) and Imperial Reinforcements (V) (Virtual Set 2); Imperial Domination (V), General Veers (V), Blizzard 1 (V), Blizzard 2 (V) and Blizzard Scout 1 (V) (Virtual Set 4). ovs_pick returned Virtual Set 21/17 for Praji and Blizzard 1 (modern sets, not legal in 2004); the newest original-era printing is used. The draft had dropped the (V) on Imperial Domination, Veers and the three Blizzards.
* Janus Greejatus x2 is a unique character; dested as posted.

== Strategy ==

Strategy: Win battles. Flip. Duel Luke. If you lose the duel and have enough cards on Insignificant Rebellion, you win.

Pre-first turn: pull Carida or Rendili (doesn't matter)

First turn: deploy Carida or Rendili. deploy the Endor docking bay and put Palpy there (unless you think that he'll get beatdown next turn, then deploy the dsII docking bay and put palpy there instead) and pull Force Lightning. this is why I don't use the combo of Mob. Pts. because you activate an extra force 2nd turn if you control the docking bay

Rest of game: go to your opponent's sites. with the AT-ATs drawing 2 destinies and trampling people and canceling game text with the chicken walker and Vader walking around you should win some battles. win battles in space with Imperial Command either limiting their destinies or adding to yours. noone can draw more than 2 destinies because of Imperial Domination(V) so keep that in mind. when you start a battle you retrieve an Imperial, and when you win you retrieve an Imperial.

if they think they're tricky and put Luke in some obscure place without a docking bay, put the <>docking bay there, grab Luke and if you've won enough battles (4 or 5 is good) then Bring Him Before Palpy and duel. your opponent loses 3 force if he loses the duel, and loses the game if he wins the duel!
